notes.consoleErrors: All console errors recorded are axe-core XHR preloads of styles.css blocked under file:// (CORS); they appear only on runs where axe was injected (none at 768, where axe was not run). The prototype itself logged no errors or page exceptions.
notes.focusTrap: Native <dialog>.showModal(): Tab cycles close button -> document/browser chrome -> close button. No page element outside the dialog was ever reachable; background is inert (programmatic focus on a tab failed). Raw assertion fails because activeElement becomes <body>; interpreted as expected native behaviour, not a defect.
notes.impeccableLive: impeccable live was not run: it requires creating .impeccable/live/config.json and injecting a script tag into project files. The same browser detector bundle (detect-antipatterns-browser.js from the installed impeccable plugin) was injected via Playwright addScriptTag instead; no server was started.
